headline: Approved FY27 vehicle purchases up to $1,974,788, accepted a $1,274,268 court diversion grant, and referred the Vegetation Ordinance to committee.
summary: The council approved entertainment permits for Thingz From Yaad (152 Cherry Street), Citizen Cider's CiderFest, and PartizanFilm's Rocky Horror Picture Show showing (230 College Street), while removing the PoutineFest USA permit from the agenda. It approved the FY27 Fleet Purchasing List not to exceed $1,974,788.00, accepted a $1,274,268 State of Vermont grant for court diversion services, referred the amended Vegetation Ordinance to the Ordinance Committee, and appointed Councilor Bergman to the Board of Finance. The council also held work sessions on an overdose prevention center report and an update from the Ad-Hoc Tax Fairness Committee, and met in executive session on a personnel matter.
decisions: Approved the FY27 Fleet Purchasing List, authorizing vehicle purchases not to exceed $1,974,788.00.
Accepted a $1,274,268 State of Vermont grant (#02100-FY27-CN) for court diversion and pretrial services through June 30, 2027.
Approved the 2026-2027 Indoor Entertainment Permit for Thingz From Yaad, 152 Cherry Street.
Approved a one-day outdoor entertainment permit for Citizen Cider's CiderFest on October 3, 2026 at 180 Flynn Avenue.
Removed the PoutineFest USA outdoor entertainment permit application (377 Pine Street, October 4, 2026) from the agenda.
Approved a one-day indoor entertainment permit for PartizanFilm, Inc. to show The Rocky Horror Picture Show at 230 College Street on October 31, 2026, with two councilors recusing.
Referred the amended Vegetation Ordinance (BCO Chapter 29) to the City Council Ordinance Committee.
Appointed Councilor Bergman to the Board of Finance.
